title: Stage-2 reminder continue-link only reaches drafts with a pre-minted token; auto-saved drafts (token NULL) get the plain 'Start your application' URL
evidence:
list_resumable_draft_tokens.sql:
SELECT email, COALESCE(continue_token, '') AS continue_token
FROM application_draft
WHERE vacancy_id = $1::uuid
  AND submitted_at IS NULL
  AND continue_token IS NOT NULL;

upsert_application_draft.sql (the only draft-creation path — no token minted on auto-save):
INSERT INTO application_draft (vacancy_id, email, fields)
VALUES ($1::uuid, lower($2), $3::jsonb)

inbound_handler.gleam:839-841:
    let continue_url = case dict.get(draft_tokens, string.lowercase(email)) {
      Ok(token) if token != "" -> application_url <> "/resume/" <> token
      _ -> ""
    }
detail: Frozen spec AC: 'Given a stage-2 reminder to an enquirer with a draft ... its CTA is the tokenized continue-link; without a draft it stays the plain application URL.' Tokens are minted only by claim_continue_link_send (the 'Email me a link' button), so debounced-auto-save drafts — the exact abandonment cohort the D+6 'continue where you left off' reminder targets — have NULL tokens and get the pre-F3 generic CTA; their drafts are unreachable from the email.
recommended_fix: Mint tokens for tokenless live drafts at reminder-prefetch time (claim-style UPDATE ... SET continue_token = COALESCE(continue_token, <per-row random>) before the SELECT), so every live (unsubmitted) draft maps to a continue-link CTA.
